evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement: fix(relay): Remove raw connector response population logic for unreferenced refunds ## Type of Change - [x] Bugfix - [ ] New feature - [ ] Enhancement - [ ] Refactoring - [ ] Dependency updates - [ ] Documentation - [ ] CI/CD ## Description The raw connector response contains connector authentication details, which could potentially expose sensitive credentials. Therefore, we removed storing the raw connector response in the relay response_data column. ### Additional Changes - [ ] This PR modifies the API contract - [ ] This PR modifies the database schema - [ ] This PR modifies application configuration/environment variables ## Motivation and Context ## How did you test it? ``` curl --location 'http://localhost:8080/relay/unreferenced_refund' \ --header 'Accept: application/json' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --header 'X-Profile-Id: pro_OGLiyjG7xQV4mQsJg5gW' \ --header 'api-key:{{}}' \ --data '{ "amount": 1000, "currency": "USD", "connector_id": "mca_KcAExAwgsADVEKKUSydK", "customer_id": "cus_xxx", "connector_resource_id": "cnx_123", "recipient_payment_method_data": { "card": { "card_number": "6011000990139424", "card_exp_month": "03", "card_exp_year": "30" } } }' ``` ## Checklist - [x] I formatted the code `cargo +nightly fmt --all` - [x] I addressed lints thrown by `cargo clippy` - [x] I reviewed the submitted code - [ ] I added unit tests for my changes where possible
